title: Explore what your project knows
summary: Pick a record on this project's graph, read it in plain words, check the fields behind it, and follow a link to the next one. Four clicks, on this project's own records.

steps.text: This is the project's graph. Each dot is a record RRFlow holds, and each line is a link between two records. Bigger dots have more links.
steps.action: Click any dot, or a record in the list on the right.

steps.text: The panel on the right explains what you picked, in plain words first. Details shows the exact fields RRFlow holds behind those words.
These are the records this one links to, and the records that link to it.
steps.action: Click a linked record, or another dot if this one has no links.

steps.text: A big project is easier to read a small area at a time.
steps.action: Press Show what is around it.

steps.text: Now the graph shows only this record and what it touches. You went from a dot, to the fields behind it, to its neighbours, all on this project's own records.
